entry.cost_basis: ESTIMATE (*est.), SIZE/ARCHITECTURE-CLASS reference Qwen/Qwen3.5-35B-A3B at USD 0.3125/M input and 1.25/M output; not an author tariff or pod price; output 0 under the zero-output convention. The frozen pricing_v15 module (sha256 645fd82eac728d597048bec0995ecd3ac896566e269fb6c9a1fdb84c171a9ac4, re-frozen 26 Oct 2026) has no listing for the card's declared base ornith-ai/Ornith-1.5-35B-A3B (reference() refuses it as lacking an explicit market-listing decision, checked on this module), and that base declares no parent of its own. The class reference is therefore matched by architecture only (qwen3_5_moe, 35B total / 3B active parameters) and applied as an explicit labelled pair: Qwen/Qwen3.5-35B-A3B at USD 0.3125/M input and 1.25/M output, the module's catalog listing for that class, at its full pair. No base key is registered and no lineage is asserted between the two models. Estimated, not charged, not a quote from the author or any host. INPUT BASIS: the usage block reports the actual prompt token count of each answered request: 621,390 input tokens across the 1,495 answered items, identical to our first-party offline count of the same prompts (0 usage mismatches). The 5 items refused with HTTP 400 context_length_exceeded at the author's 16,384-token endpoint cap carry NO usage, are never billed, and stay in the denominator of the per-1,000-decisions cost. OUTPUT: the model is a classifier and generates no text; output_tokens is 0 and, under the zero-output convention for native-probability rows, output is priced at USD 0/M. Native usage on the fixed 1,489-item basis: 618,462 input tokens and 0 output tokens on the 1,489 common items. COST FIGURES: USD 0.129798 per 1,000 decisions, 2.01x the official cost cap USD 0.064595. Cost on the 1,489 items every row on this draw answered (same-items rule); all-items cost USD 0.129456 per 1,000 decisions.
entry.disclosure: Umpire 35B-A3B is a 35B-total, 3B-active mixture-of-experts model (qwen3_5_moe architecture), declared base ornith-ai/Ornith-1.5-35B-A3B, with final-position option-slot logits. AUTHOR CLAIM: these BF16 weights are the author's served 4-bit weights dequantized; tensor parity was not established. Only the BF16 CUDA path was measured; no MLX or other weight variant was measured. SERVING: the author's unchanged Transformers server, BF16, use_cache false, logits_to_keep 1, temperature 1, up to 255 option slots, thinking off, one forward pass, no generated text, truncation, retries or ensemble. The vLLM engine was not started. Contributor code ran only on a disposable rented pod with network cut. KERNEL PATH: flash-linear-attention and causal-conv1d were unavailable; Transformers' reference PyTorch linear-attention path is inferred from server warnings, not kernel tracing; no separate scored-run kernel trace was captured. ITEMS: all 1,500 items were sent; exactly 5 exceeded the native 16,384-token input limit, matching the preregistered count, and returned HTTP 400 context_length_exceeded, scored as misses and kept in the denominator; these carry no usage and are unbilled. 1,495 items were answered. Boundary checks answered 16,384 tokens and refused 16,385, 80,000 and 84,000 tokens with normal recovery. TOKENS: output tokens reported as 0; native input usage was 621,390 tokens on answered requests, identical to first-party offline counts with 0 usage mismatches. A one-option request returns deterministically with zero usage. TOKENIZER: exact prompt bytes, slot ids, encoded ids and usage matched over 543 public and synthetic cases, including 231 public rows. TRAINING: the card claims Open-Jev probability-distribution training and its own public test numbers; these claims were not independently verified. Training data were not inspected; overlap with public or sealed JevBench items is unchecked. DETERMINISM: 49 of 50 replayed requests were bit-identical, with 0 argmax flips (recorded maximum probability difference 0.0). WARM-UP: public pre-warm preceded the scored fresh server's timed requests; separate public smoke recorded about 22 seconds for model loading and 21 seconds for warm-up. LATENCY: measured loopback p50 0.405 s, p95 0.494 s, maximum 0.627 s; no request took 10 seconds or longer. The share view applies the common self-hosted latency assumption, twice measured p50 plus 0.15 s, an assumption rather than a hosted-endpoint measurement. HARDWARE: one A100 80 GB GPU; weights alone occupy 64.6 GiB. No peak-memory measurement is available. LICENCE: weights CC BY-NC 4.0 (non-commercial use only); serving code Apache-2.0, with MIT SemIf notice preserved. One scored run, with every pre-input gate passed before scored input. The 27 Oct 2026 draw is not yet equated to the reference scale (offset 0). This draw has no subject-topic labels yet, so the row has no topic cells; use-case and language cells are measured on its own draw.
entry.endpoint_condition: Self-hosted on one evaluator-rented Verda NVIDIA A100-SXM4-80GB in Finland (EU), using the author's unchanged Transformers HTTP server on loopback; BF16, no vLLM engine. Measured 29 Oct 2026. Public warm-up preceded timed measurements. Model, source and input were read-only, network cut before scored input. GPU rental is separate from the estimated model tariff.
